title: Watch the Ball
style: afro jazz big band, female lead vocal, brass and percussion, 92 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
Every coach. Every court.
Same first instruction.
Watch the ball.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Eyes on the ball from the moment it leaves
Watch the paddle face, feel the breeze
Track it all the way to your own
Eyes on the ball, never alone

[VERSE 2 - Kazakh transliteration]
Dopty kozingmen baqyla
Raketin betinen, yeldi sen
Ozingge deiyn baqlap bar
Dopty kozingmen, jalgyz emes

[VERSE 3 - Swati transliteration]
Buka libhola ngeso kusuka lapho liphuma
Buka inhloko yebhola, uzwe umoya
Libekelele lonkhe kufika kuwe
Buka libhola, awukho wedvwa

[CHORUS]
WATCH - BAQYLA - BUKA - GLEDAJ
EYES ON THE BALL - ALL THE WAY
WATCH THE BALL - EVERY SHOT
TRACK IT HOME - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Bosnian transliteration]
Prati loptu ocima od trenutka kad odlazi
Gledaj lice reketa, osjeti povjetarac
Prati je sve do sebe
Oci na loptu, nikad sam

[VERSE 5 - Maltese]
Ara l-ballun mill-mument li jitlaq
Segwi l-wicc tal-pala, hoss ir-rih
Segwih sa ghandek
Ghajnejk fuq il-ballun, qatt wahidek

[VERSE 6 - Estonian transliteration]
Silmad pallil hetkest kui see lahkub
Jalgi reketipinda, tunne tuult
Jalita seda kogu tee sinuni
Silmad pallil, kunagi pole uksi

[CHORUS]
WATCH - BAQYLA - BUKA - GLEDAJ
EYES ON THE BALL - ALL THE WAY
WATCH THE BALL - EVERY SHOT
TRACK IT HOME - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Kazakh. Swati. Bosnian. Maltese. Estonian.
Eyes on the ball.
Same in every language.
Watch it. Track it. All the way.

[FINAL CHORUS]
WATCH - BAQYLA - BUKA - GLEDAJ
EYES ON THE BALL - ALL THE WAY
WATCH THE BALL - EVERY SHOT
TRACK IT HOME - EVERY TIME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE FOCUS
EYES ON THE BALL - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
Watch the ball.
